Locally hosted browser export libraries, loaded only when exporting:

- SheetJS CE xlsx 0.18.5, mini browser build (Apache-2.0; LICENSE-xlsx.txt)
- jsPDF 4.2.1, UMD browser build (MIT; LICENSE-jspdf.txt)
- jsPDF-AutoTable 5.0.9 (MIT; LICENSE-autotable.txt)

Exports are generated in the browser from filtered application rows. Workbook user values are written as string/numeric cells, never as formulas. No external service receives transaction data.
